scale.0: No active verification found; fixtures, uninvoked helpers and disabled automated tests do not establish coverage.
scale.1-2: Mention, narrow presence check or incidental exercised entry; no complete user outcome.
scale.3-4: Partial happy path; consequential outcomes or stable checks missing.
scale.5: Basic complete happy path with meaningful outcome verification.
scale.6-7: Happy path and several important variants or recovery intents; material gaps remain.
scale.8-9: Broad important-intent and major-variant coverage with substantial stable checks; limited named gaps.
scale.10: Ideal important-intent coverage for this feature, including major variants and all meaningful stable checks; no meaningful gap identified.

rubric.desktop_scope: Computer desktop/web Suite test coverage. Record actual Electron/web restrictions; Electron-only capabilities need compatible desktop tests.
rubric.android_scope: Android-capable Detox E2E and Android-applicable native manual procedures. Exclude iOS-only tests.
rubric.manual_scope: Quality of written manual procedures, not proof of execution. describe.skip is the repository convention for manual procedures and does not invalidate them.
rules: Review test bodies and called assertion/page-object helpers; mappings and title counts are only discovery aids.
Do not inherit parent references into children or use a single ancestor scenario as evidence for every descendant.
Evaluate high-level features against their meaningful intents; do not blindly average children or take their maximum.
0 is allowed and required for absent verification. Do not convert absence to 1.
Keep unavailable-platform score 0 with applicability not-supported unless a test actually verifies the unsupported-state intent.
Use active automated evidence only for positive automated scores. Preserve relevant skipped evidence with explicit caveats.
Name important uncovered intents and explain intermediate scores. Avoid unexplained high scores.
No application tests are being executed by this source-quality review.

limitations: Source-quality review only: no automated tests, app/device flows or manual procedures were executed.

Desktop scores include computer web/Electron scenarios; evidence notes web-only, desktop-only and mocked-provider limitations. Optional model-tagged tests have differing PR/nightly selection and do not imply every scenario runs on every change.
Android scores exclude iOS-only residence cases and the skipped Suite Sync describe block. Emulator-driven Android flows do not establish real USB/Bluetooth radio or OS pairing behavior.
Manual scores describe the quality of written verification steps; describe.skip is their normal procedure container, not proof of absence or execution. Placeholder files with no steps receive zero.
Unit/component tests and fixture construction are intentionally excluded from automated E2E scores.
A source search can establish no found verification, not prove no external/private manual test plan exists. No external test-management execution data was available.
Source-quality assessment only: no application, emulator, automated suite or manual procedure was executed. Scores assess checked intents, not passing rate, flakiness or runtime availability.

Desktop includes shared computer web/Electron behavior. Web-only CSV/download/BIP329/legacy-label scenarios and Electron-only pending-mining scenarios are identified in evidence. Optional model/network cases count as maintained executable coverage but are not guaranteed on every PR run.

Android selection excludes @iosOnly. Active regtest send/receive are T3T1/T3W1 and tracker tests are @noDevice; this is not proof of behavior on every Trezor model. Entire native Suite Sync describe.skip contributes no active automated credit.

Manual describe.skip containers are assessed as written procedures, not inactive automation. Broad generic instructions receive lower scores than concrete expected outcomes. Steps do not inherit assertions from automated-test references in prerequisites.

Absence means no concrete verification located during whole-suite searches plus focused body/helper review. SDK-only Connect tests, unit tests, fixtures, uninvoked helper capabilities and ancestor references do not establish UI E2E leaf coverage.

Native asset-detail generic graph wording was traced through AssetDetailHeader/AssetDetailPriceSection to AssetPriceChart; it covers only range selection/persistence, not historical market data. Initial camera permission grant is not restored-permission coverage.

Android Send happy-path quality credits the helper wait for TransactionDetail as a successful broadcast outcome: source tracing shows navigation requires the fulfilled send txid. This does not establish correctness of detail amounts/fees/status fields or the contents of review screens.
Static source-quality review only; no tests executed. Scores do not measure pass rate, stability or execution recency.
Desktop combines computer web/Electron. Yield/TRX and some trading/history scenarios are webOnly; SDK permission scenarios desktopOnly. Scores do not imply every project runs all checks.
Android excludes iosOnly residence tests through runner grep. No active automated native staking/yield tests found.
Trade/staking/yield use controlled provider/chain/broadcast state. Verified UI/device and mock-driven results do not establish real provider payment/settlement.
Manual describe.skip is the procedure container convention. Scores measure written quality without claiming execution. Conditional optional steps limit completeness.
WalletConnect is separate from SDK popup signing. Native WC UI is unexposed/stubbed despite broad base-manifest conditional availability; SDK message/typed-data tests do not verify WC requests.
Zero means no qualifying feature-specific checks found in searched suites/helpers. Adjacent fixtures, unused helpers, send/settings procedures and parent references are not inherited into children.
